delivered_artifacts.artifact_class: Executable Workflow IR Domain Models, Validator, Diff Engine & Compiler Adapter

gate_1_ir_validates_before_compilation.description: ExecutableWorkflowIR structural, node-uniqueness, and edge-endpoint validity verified before runtime compilation.

gate_2_canonicalized_identity.description: Equivalent source graphs with scrambled node/edge declarations produce identical cryptographic SHA-256 digests.

gate_3_controlled_cycle_law.description: Undeclared/unbounded cycles are rejected fail-closed; host-bounded loops with finite iteration policies are accepted.

gate_4_branch_conditions_and_targets.description: Condition and switch branch targets are verified to exist in the graph, preventing dangling branches.

gate_5_runtime_compiler_authority.description: WorkflowIRCompiler compiles canonical IR into runtime projection dictionaries compatible with validate_runtime_workflow.
